name: Media Manager
description: Owner-operated Usenet movie and TV manager with evidence-based indexer selection, one AltMount job per title, Plex-safe symlinks, and exact Plex confirmation.
longDescription:
Media Manager owns the workflow from a Seerr or manual request through evidence-based Newznab indexer selection, one AltMount download job, read-only output verification, Plex-safe managed symlinks, and exact Plex confirmation.

It is built for a single owner and a deliberate, auditable pipeline: every search records its indexer evidence, every failed release is explained, and a title is only marked successful after Plex confirms the exact path and provider identity.

Requirements: AltMount for Usenet acquisition with its FUSE output configured read-only, Plex for publication/confirmation, at least one Newznab-compatible indexer, and a TMDB API read access token for discovery and metadata. Seerr/Overseerr/Jellyseerr is optional.

This Cosmos app installs the API, UI and PostgreSQL together, creates the UI, /api and /health routes on one host, and injects the owner token server-side on /api. After install, add your AltMount and Plex connections, commission an indexer, create a library root and quality profile, then add a title.
